description: A glass SSO button (Google or Apple) for the register screen. Google shows a Skeleton label while its auth request initializes instead of an opacity-dimmed 'broken' look.

loading.description: Google only: true while !googleRequest — renders Skeleton label

disabled.description: True while submitting or (google) while loading

platformGating: Apple button renders only when Platform.OS === 'ios'

accessibility.loadingHint: Announces 'loading' rather than appearing dead when the request is not ready.
